name: Weisser Valley
ruler: Adelmara II "the Stern" von Burghstedt, Elector-Princess of Westermark, Duchess of the Weisser Valley, Countess of Burghstadt & Vanquisher of the Iom'Harun Tribes
description: Westermark's founding duchy and the seat of the Elector-Princess herself, who holds the ducal title directly rather than granting it to a vassal Duke. A fertile river valley of wheat fields and floodplains around the royal capital, Burghstadt.

name: Skallheim
ruler: Duke Maromar II von Skallburgh, Duke of Skallheim, Count of Skallburgh and Warden of the western border
description: A mining duchy in the White Mountain foothills, rich in iron, copper, tin, lead and salt. Its western marches hold Westermark's chain of border fortresses facing the Iron Dominion.

name: Mysthalinn
ruler: Duchess Theralda I von Kliffstadt, Duchess of Mysthalinn & Countess of Kliffstadt
description: A mountainous, mineral-rich duchy of moorland and caverns along Westermark's southern and eastern frontier, bordering the Iomharun Clanlands and the neighbouring princedom of Marova.

name: Möwenmark
ruler: Duke Alaric von Grauhaven, Duke of Möwenmark, Count of Grauhaven & Warden of the Merriddian Coast
description: Westermark's coastal duchy, holding the princedom's main bluewater port and international trade at Grauhaven, backed by dense timber-producing forestland further inland.
